messages:
jaime: spotting elevated 5xx for the reranker service after the latest canary. Looks like a quant path regression for small-batch long-seq. We need a hotfix and expedited approval. Target image: redwood/reranker:hotfix-2026-03. Can we do a 20% canary instead of 5% given low traffic?
nick: Who's taking the deploy? We need rollback signal and release-note blurb.
jaime: I'll own deploy. Rollback criteria: service 5xx rate >0.5% absolute increase OR throughput drop >30% sustained for 2 minutes. Also auto-unwind if memory climbs >85% on any node.
deploy-bot: Release request accepted for redwood/reranker:hotfix-2026-03. Canary plan: 20% -> 50% (5m) -> 100% if green. ETA start 1745558920.
sre-oncall: Oncall here, ack. I'll shadow and have rollback ready. Please add an incident tag for tracking.
ops-liaison: FYI customer-impacting routing policy in eu-west will be excluded from canary to avoid cross-region flakiness.
release-eng: Add release note: "Reranker: fix quantized attention indexing causing intermittent 5xx under long sequences; no schema changes."
nick: Approved for expedited. Leave traffic ramp automation enabled; hit me if telemetry degrades.
deploy-bot: Canary launched at 1745558920 on pool rerank-eu-canary (20%).
jaime: Quick smoke: 0.1% 5xx in canary, p95 latency stable at 180ms.
sre-oncall: Monitoring dashboard link: https://metrics.redwood/s/reranker/hotfix-2026-03. Will intervene on thresholds.
deploy-bot: Canary advanced to 50% at 1745558980. Running 5m hold.
ops-liaison: Canary excluded eu-west routing; verifying non-canary users unaffected.
release-eng: Final release notes link ready to paste after full roll: https://redwood.internal/releases/notes/1745558888
deploy-bot: Rollout completed to 100% at 1745559060. No auto-rollback.
jaime: Deployed and monitoring. Post-deploy summary: 5xx returned to baseline and latency slightly improved. Will prepare a short changelog entry and follow-up eval.
nick: Thanks all. :thumbsup:
